blocks.text: Filipino-Japanese artist ena mori emerged as the recipient of the Best Asian Creative Artist accolade at the recently held 17th Golden Indie Music Awards in Taiwan. The award, announced during the ceremony held last Saturday, Oct. 31, was given in recognition of mori’s EP, “Ore.” “My child, ‘Ore,’ received a little present this year from the Golden Indie Music Awards in Taiwan!” she said through her Instagram page on Tuesday, Nov. 3, sharing a glimpse of her acceptance speech shown on the screen during the awarding event. “Thank you GIMA for recognizing this record.
